# Vox.chat

> AI automation platform for local service businesses — voice agents, AI receptionists, and review automation. Your business, never offline.

## What this is
Vox.chat provides AI automation tools built for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and service contractors. Three core products: an AI phone agent that answers calls 24/7 and books appointments, an AI receptionist that captures website leads and answers FAQs, and an automated review system that gets more Google reviews after every job.

## Services
- **Vox Voice** ($995/mo) — AI answers business phone 24/7, qualifies callers, books appointments
- **Vox Receptionist** ($550/mo) — AI chat trained on your services, captures leads, schedules appointments
- **Vox Reviews** ($595/mo) — automated post-job texts driving Google reviews, negative feedback alerts
- **Bundle** — all three for $1,500/mo
- **HIPAA Compliance add-on** ($2,500/mo) — for healthcare/dental
- **Zero Data Retention add-on** ($1,500/mo) — for legal/finance

## Target market
Solo operators and small service contractors (5-15 techs) — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, general contractors. Central Valley, CA focus expanding nationally.
